existing_runtime.gate: proposal inspection and ALLOW/BLOCK only; no executor
existing_runtime.execution: no action runner, callback, or post-action return path
existing_runtime.observation: artifact_observer hashes selected artifacts only; not lifecycle-linked
existing_runtime.verification: V1.1 supports fact-specific verification; no runtime lifecycle verifier
existing_runtime.factual_context: research-only submitted-record model; not active lifecycle production

identities.observation: observation_id/assertion_id with observer, source instance, scope, and times

execution.targets: separate zero_or_many targets; never copied from proposal
execution.status: no new enum authorized; explicit source reports only may map to V1.1 STATE
execution.outcome: distinct from completion; source claim or later observation only

conflict_and_unknown: retain conflicting attributed evidence; UNKNOWN and absence are not false

v11_adequacy.gap: no neutral typed execution-to-originating-proposal relation; opaque metadata is not a consumable link

first_slice: test-only caller-supplied execution record to neutral V1.1 evidence; no automatic gate conversion, observation, outcome, verification, or regulator consumer
